statement: Define tenfold on an end-to-end metric, time to qualified design (TTQD): wall-clock from a written brief to the first design and controller that pass a frozen acceptance test, measured for FrankenRobotics and for an incumbent arm driven by the same agent model and token budget on host trj.

Acceptance = success rate over held-out randomized scenarios in a referee simulator that neither pipeline trained in, thresholds fixed before any run. Incumbent arm = Playground or mjlab on MuJoCo Warp, or Isaac Lab, plus a thin tool layer, configurations published. Median over at least five campaign seeds with a bootstrap interval; runs that fail within budget are censored, not dropped; cold and warm caches reported separately; also GPU-hours, tokens, and best acceptance score at 1 h and 8 h. The phase ledger must sum to wall-clock within 2%.
